seo.description: The academic and creative portfolio of Nafis Tamim, featuring verified ICSC 2026 ambassador recognition, mathematics honours, research, visual design and selected projects.

identity.descriptor: A student of science, ideas and possibility

hero.intro: I move between mathematics, research, creative design, computing and writing—following questions wherever they lead. This is a living record of the work, the thinking and the evidence.
hero.stageText: Problems worth solving, ideas worth testing.
hero.smallCaption: Proof over promises. Curiosity over categories.

about.heading: A mind that doesn't stay in one discipline.
about.lead: I believe ideas become stronger when science meets storytelling, logic meets imagination, and careful research meets real execution.
about.body: My work includes independent technical experiments, graphic and brand design, academic writing, mathematics challenges and participation in international student initiatives. I value the process behind an outcome as much as the outcome itself.
about.quote: The most interesting answers often begin with a better question.

achievements.heading: A record of doing, not just dreaming.
achievements.intro: Selected honours and academic milestones. Open each card to examine its context and supporting evidence.

cards.title: Top 1 Ambassador — 2026
cards.summary: Ranked #1 on ICSC's official 2026 Top Ambassadors leaderboard.
cards.details: The 2026 ICSC Top Ambassadors page places Nafis Tamim at number one. This is a leaderboard position in ambassador outreach, distinct from participant exam rankings. The leaderboard can update over time.

cards.title: Most Participants — Ambassador Award
cards.summary: Named recipient of the ICSC 2026 Most Participants Ambassador Award.
cards.details: ICSC's official 2026 results announcement names Nafis Tamim under the Ambassador Awards category 'Most Participants'.

cards.title: Silver Honour
cards.summary: Silver Honour recognition in the International Youth Math Challenge, as reported by Nafis Tamim.
cards.details: Mathematics competition recognition. Certificate and individual verification details can be attached through the Portfolio Studio.

cards.title: National First Place — Essay Competition
cards.summary: First place nationally in an essay-writing competition organized by the International Mother Language Institute, as reported by Nafis Tamim.
cards.details: An academic writing milestone. The result sheet, certificate or official recipient announcement can be uploaded to this entry.

projects.heading: Different mediums. One way of thinking.
projects.intro: Not everything I create is a website. Explore software concepts, independent experiments, branding, design systems and other work.

items.title: GRAPHLAIR
items.subtitle: Visual identity & digital initiative
items.summary: A creative initiative exploring graphic design, contemporary branding, and digital identity.
items.challenge: How can a visual system feel recognizable and purposeful across different formats?
items.process: Experimenting with brand language, composition, repeatable elements and online presentation.
items.outcome: A publicly accessible creative project and source repository.
items.tools: Brand design, web presentation, visual communication

items.title: MonerBondhu AI
items.subtitle: An AI product exploration
items.summary: A publicly accessible repository exploring ideas in AI-assisted digital products.
items.challenge: How do you translate a broad AI idea into something usable and thoughtfully scoped?
items.process: Exploring product questions, experiments, and iterative interface decisions.
items.outcome: Public project repository; claims of deployment or user impact are not yet made.

items.title: Footwear Solution Bangladesh
items.subtitle: Branding & visual communication
items.summary: Visual branding work produced for Footwear Solution Bangladesh (FSBD), spanning brand presentation and creative concepts.
items.challenge: Communicate an industry-focused identity through compelling, professional graphic language.
items.process: Exploring graphic composition, editorial layouts and consistent branded visuals.
items.outcome: Artwork and project documentation can be added to the gallery.

items.title: A Living Academic Portfolio
items.subtitle: Designing the presentation of evidence
items.summary: A publication-style digital portfolio designed to present academic work, creative output and recognition with context.
items.challenge: How do you represent a multidisciplinary student without making every project look like software engineering?
items.process: Evidence-led structure, responsive design, accessible interaction and a content administration workflow.
